name: Zhe Kuang Heavy Industry Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Zhe Kuang Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. operates as a comprehensive provider of heavy mining equipment across China. The company manages the entire lifecycle of its products, from initial research and development and manufacturing to sales and subsequent after-sales support. Its extensive product catalog features a wide range of crushing solutions, including specific models like CJ and PE jaw crushers, RC and MRC cone crushers, and VSI crushers. Beyond crushing, they also supply essential feeding and conveying systems, such as vibrating feeders and conveyor belts. Their offerings further extend to screening and washing machinery, encompassing vibrating screens and sand washing machines, complemented by sand recovery units and versatile mobile crushing plants. Notably, the company markets its cone crushers under the distinct Omais and Tiangangxing brands. Established in 2003, Zhe Kuang Heavy Industries is headquartered in Changxing, China.
